propositions: An AST-based ownership gate must enforce that only approved composition roots and seams can read configuration and credentials, rejecting direct/aliased load_config, os.getenv, os.environ access, and backend property reloads below the central seam.

Legacy ambient/per-job configuration facades, migration switches, and exception entries must be removed only after structural gates pass, behavioral oracles from S1-S6 remain green, and bounded live canaries with redacted evidence complete.

The ownership registry and config/security documentation must remain byte-current with schema and registries, with no path-glob exceptions, and both ownership and field-consumption gates must be wired into make lint and CI.

All synthetic test fixtures for prohibited access patterns, unowned registry names, and broad exceptions must fail the gate with diagnostic details; approved fixtures and the real tree must have zero direct ambient reads and empty legacy exception sets.
